descriptions.w3d_d31e_load_file_aligned_801db7a8: Opens a disc file by name and reads it whole into a 32-byte aligned buffer filled first with 0xe0: from the audio heap at 0x804ab8b4 when the flag is set, otherwise from the general aligned allocator. On a read error frees the buffer and returns null without closing; on success closes the file and returns the buffer. Open, read and close signatures are read from the call sites; names are inferred.
